photo.caption: Enlargeable, detailed map of Rwanda
photo.alt: Detailed map of Rwanda showing towns, roads, lakes and international borders
photo.description: This map of Rwanda shows the country's cities, towns, villages and some other geographical details, and is likely the most comprehensive map of the country in this respect that you'll find anywhere online. It has been stitched together from panels of Open Street Map (which is freely licensed to all) with details plotted by the uploader.
